title: coelogyne brevilabris
intro: Coelogyne brevilabris, commonly known as the Lipstick Orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. The Lipstick Orchid has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Coelogyne brevilabris include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which make it effective in treating infections and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the Lipstick Orchid include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
